property: Within a process incarnation, accepted state-machine progress never publishes a lower last-applied index after a later prefix has become visible. Its applied values must remain consistent with that prefix.
method: Observe serialized publication events for process-incarnation last_applied and state digests. Reject any decrease without an explicitly declared restart; independently compare values against committed prefix.
witness_requirements: Earlier apply completion, later snapshot prefix, publication events, task identities, same incarnation and observed regression. Normal monotonic metric sampling alone may miss a transient regression.
